official_measurement_examples.name: 2026 Direction publication date
official_measurement_examples.fact: The Town and Country Planning (Consultation) (England) Direction 2026 was published on 31 March 2026.

official_measurement_examples.name: 2026 refusal-side housing trigger
official_measurement_examples.fact: The Direction applies to applications including 150 or more houses/flats not determined before 11 May 2026, where the LPA proposes to refuse.

official_measurement_examples.name: 2024 and 2026 direction roles
official_measurement_examples.fact: Current PPG distinguishes the 2024 Direction for specified proposed grants from the 2026 Direction for specified proposed refusals.

official_measurement_examples.name: Consultation versus call-in
official_measurement_examples.fact: PPG states the Directions give the Secretary of State an opportunity to consider using section 77 call-in powers; consultation itself is not call-in.

official_measurement_examples.name: Consultation holding period
official_measurement_examples.fact: Current PPG says relevant applications cannot be determined until 21 days after specified information is received by the Secretary of State, or 18 days for public service infrastructure, unless otherwise directed.

official_measurement_examples.name: Called-in guidance currency
official_measurement_examples.fact: Planning Inspectorate called-in planning applications guidance was last updated 20 July 2026.

official_measurement_examples.name: Decision collection currency
official_measurement_examples.fact: The called-in decisions and recovered appeals collection was last updated 16 July 2026.

official_measurement_examples.name: March-May 2026 consultation status
official_measurement_examples.fact: The consultation proposing further referral measures ran 23 March to 4 May 2026; its commercial, nuclear and Defence DEPZ measures were consultation proposals and must not be treated as final Directions without later enacted evidence.

core_rules: consultation direction referral is not call-in
Secretary of State consultation is not planning permission
call-in is not planning permission granted
call-in is not planning permission refused
LPA resolution to grant is not permission issued
LPA resolution to refuse is not refusal notice issued
2026 Direction applies only to its specified 150-plus dwelling refusal cases
150 dwellings is not a general planning approval threshold
11 May 2026 applicability date must be preserved
2024 grant-side and 2026 refusal-side Directions must remain distinct
consultation proposal is not an adopted Direction
proposed commercial threshold must not be treated as final current Direction without enacted evidence
proposed nuclear referral requirement must not be treated as final current Direction without enacted evidence
proposed Defence DEPZ referral requirement must not be treated as final current Direction without enacted evidence
21-day consultation hold is procedural not permission
18-day public-service-infrastructure hold is procedural not permission
expiry of consultation period does not automatically grant planning permission
call-in power must be exercised before the LPA issues formal permission
third-party request for call-in is not a call-in direction
call-in policy considers issues of more than local importance but does not create an automatic trigger
decision to call in does not predetermine planning merits
Inspector recommendation in a called-in case is not the Secretary of State final decision
completion of public inquiry is not planning permission
final decision letter is the authoritative casework outcome
recovered appeal and called-in application must remain distinct
appeal recovery can occur before the appeal decision and is not a post-decision relabelling
recovered appeal means Secretary of State decides taking the Inspector report into account
appeal submitted is not a recovered appeal
appeal outcome in another case is not parcel approval probability
section 62A direct application route is distinct from call-in
section 62A designation does not mean every planning application goes directly to the Secretary of State
section 62A direct application is not automatic grant
planning propriety guidance is process guidance not planning merits evidence
ministerial representation is not a formal planning decision
current Direction text must override consultation-stage proposals
source and update dates must be preserved for referral rules
specific safeguarding or other referral directions can create separate consultation requirements
Consultation Direction referral is distinct from statutory-consultee consultation
statutory consultee objection is not call-in
Planning Casework Unit referral is not planning permission
absence of an immediate Secretary of State response is not an automatic merits outcome except as the exact Direction provides
called-in decision collection is case history not parcel approval probability
national case history must not be downscaled into parcel call-in risk
historic called-in decisions must be read against policy and law at their decision date
NO_DATA must not become no Secretary of State intervention risk
research confidence is not parcel call-in or approval probability
no parcel call-in outcome planning permission or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
business rows remain zero until canonical recovery completes
